label: Negotiations
description: Serve a public HTTP tool that lets an external agent find which Polish cities sell specific electronics components needed for a wind turbine.

steps.label: Load CSV data
steps.detail: Download and parse cities.csv, items.csv, and connections.csv from the hub data endpoint

steps.label: Start HTTP server
steps.detail: Listen for POST /search requests from the external agent on NEGOTIATIONS_PORT (default 3002)

steps.label: Register tools
steps.detail: Submit the public tool URL and description to the hub via hubVerify so the external agent can find it

steps.label: Handle item queries
steps.detail: On each agent request, use LLM to extract Polish keywords and search items.csv for matching city lists
